seo.title: About Valam | Why We Built a Private Money App | Valam
seo.description: The story behind Valam and Mathi, what the names mean, and the principles we build by: privacy first, plain language and no ads.

about.title: Money should feel calm, and stay yours
about.intro: Valam is a personal finance app built around one idea: you should understand your money without handing it to anyone.

story.title: Why we built Valam
paragraphs: Most money apps work by copying your financial life to their servers. That is how they show you charts, and also how they sell you things. We wanted the charts and the help without the copy.

So Valam keeps your ledger in an encrypted vault on your phone, and runs its intelligence there too. It tracks accounts, cards, loans, goals and money with friends and family, and then tells you in plain words what needs your attention.
It is built with Indian households in mind: rupees, EMIs, chit funds, UPI, bank SMS and the habit of lending to family. It also handles other currencies and the US card interest method.

items.name: Valam (வளம்)
items.body: A Tamil word for prosperity. It is the whole picture of your money, growing steadily.

items.name: Mathi (மதி)
items.body: Means good sense, and also the moon. It is the calm voice in the app that helps you decide.

items.title: Private by default
items.body: Your data stays on your phone. Anything that leaves is optional, encrypted and explained.

items.title: Plain language
items.body: No jargon. Every number comes with a reason, and Mathi explains what it checked.

items.title: No ads, no selling
items.body: We do not show ads, track you or sell data. The business is the optional Plus plan.

items.title: Calm, not noisy
items.body: We show what matters now, such as a due date or a risk, instead of a wall of charts.

before.title: Before you write
items: Check the FAQ, many answers are there.
For a bug, tell us your phone model, Android or iOS version and what you did just before.
Never send passwords, your recovery key or full card numbers. We will never ask for them.

items.title: 1. Install and secure your vault
items.body: On first launch Valam creates a random key and seals it in your phone's secure hardware. You unlock with Face ID, fingerprint or your phone PIN.
tips: Write down the recovery key shown once and keep it somewhere safe.
Add an optional extra passphrase for more protection.
You do not need an account to start.

items.title: 2. Add your accounts
items.body: Start with the accounts you use most. Add a bank account with its balance, then your credit cards and loans.
tips: For a loan, add the EMI, rate and next due date.
You can add more any time.

items.title: 3. Track or import
items.body: Log new spending in a few taps, or import history from a file or SMS. Valam sorts transactions into categories and asks only when unsure.
tips: Fix a category once and Valam remembers it.
Check the import preview before you confirm.

items.title: 4. Get guided
items.body: Open Home to see net worth and safe to spend. Ask Mathi when you are unsure, and follow the nudges Valam shows you.
tips: Turn on reminders for bills and cards.
Try the Can I afford it check before a big purchase.

import.title: Three ways to bring in your history

items.title: Bank files
items.body: Download a CSV, OFX or QFX statement from your bank and open it in Valam. Presets for ten banks map the columns for you.

items.title: Bank SMS
items.body: On Android, Valam can read bank messages from your inbox when you unlock. On iPhone, a Shortcuts link passes messages in. Nothing is uploaded.

items.title: Type as you go
items.body: Quick add takes a few taps. Many people start here and add history later.

habit.title: A two minute routine that works

items.title: Daily glance
items.body: Open Home and read your safe to spend. It takes ten seconds.

items.title: Log as you go
items.body: Add purchases when you make them, or import weekly.

items.title: Weekly review
items.body: Check the calendar for the week ahead and ask Mathi what needs attention.

newPhone.title: Switching phones
newPhone.body: Export an encrypted backup from Settings, move the file to your new phone and restore it with your passphrase. If you use Valam Plus, you can also sync with your recovery key. Keep your recovery key safe, because it is the only other way in.

items.title: Topic guard
items.body: Every message is checked first. Only money questions go forward, anything else is politely declined.

items.title: Your real numbers
items.body: Mathi reads figures from Valam's finance engine, not from guesses.

items.title: Written in plain words
items.body: The answer is written by the built in coach or by an on-device model.

items.title: Numbers checked
items.body: Figures in the reply are checked against your ledger before you see it, and a policy filter removes unsafe advice.

items.title: Built-in coach
items.body: Fast, works offline and needs no download. It covers a wide range of money questions with templates and 187 guides.

items.title: On-device model
items.body: Optionally download a small language model that runs entirely on your phone. Checked against a published hash before use.

items.title: Think harder (Plus)
items.body: For tough questions you can opt in to Google Gemini. Your question, the chat so far and Valam's figures are sent for that one answer. Transaction details, notes, people's names and files are left out.

limits.title: What Mathi will not do
items: Move or send money, or pay a bill for you
Pick specific investment products or promise returns
Chat about topics unrelated to money
Save anything without your confirmation
Ask for passwords, PINs or your recovery key
limits.note: If a message suggests you are in distress, Mathi shares helpline information such as Tele-MANAS 14416 and the emergency number 112 before anything else.

where.title: Where your data lives
rows: A file you choose, encrypted with your passphrase
Your iCloud or Google Drive, or Valam hosted
Only you, it is sealed on your phone first
Valam servers, end to end encrypted
Sent through Valam's server to Google Gemini for one answer, not kept

items.title: A random master key
items.body: Created on your phone at setup. It never leaves in readable form.

items.title: Sealed by hardware
items.body: The Secure Enclave on iPhone or Keystore on Android seals it.

items.title: Released by you
items.body: Only after Face ID, fingerprint or your phone PIN.

items.title: Used to derive keys
items.body: Your database, attachments and chat history are encrypted with keys derived from it.

items.title: Wiped on lock
items.body: When the app locks, the database closes and keys are erased from memory.

choices.title: You stay in control
items: Use the app fully with no account.
Turn sync, groups and cloud thinking on or off at any time.
Export your data as an encrypted backup.
Delete your account and cloud data from Settings.

pricing.freeMonth: Every new account gets one free month of Plus, so you can try everything before deciding.

compare.title: Free and Plus side by side

items.q: Do I need Plus to track my money?
items.a: No. Tracking, budgets, goals, loans, cards, reminders and import are all free.
Your data stays on your phone. Sync pauses and Mathi returns to the free allowance.
Credits pay for optional Think harder questions. Plus includes a daily amount, and you can buy packs that do not expire while Plus is active.
Pricing is not final. It will be shown in the app, in your local currency, before you buy.
